scope: Proposition 4.2 (Directions with nonvanishing evaluations) of the manuscript “Counterexamples to the duality conjecture for metric entropy” (preprints/Counterexamples-to-the-duality-conjecture-for-metric-entropy-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 329 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d6f9d0518a6e50d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let 0 < 𝜃 < 1 and let 𝑟, ℎ be positive integers. Put 𝑤 = 2𝐷ℎ, 𝑢 = ⌈︂ ℎ𝑤 𝜃 ⌉︂ , (4.2) and let 𝑝 be any prime satisfying 𝑝 > max{ℎ, ℎ2 𝑢2ℎ }. (4.3) There exist 𝑡1, . . . , 𝑡𝑢 ∈ 𝐸 = F𝑟 𝑝 such that, for every nonzero 𝑍 ∈ Symℎ (𝐸*), there is a set 𝑇 ⊆ [𝑢] with |[𝑢] ∖ 𝑇| ≤ 𝜃𝑢 for which 𝑍(𝑡𝑖1 , . . . , 𝑡𝑖ℎ ) ̸= 0 for all (𝑖1, . . . , 𝑖ℎ) ∈ 𝑇ℎ . (4.4) Tuples in this assertion may have repeated indices.
